chromium_policy.chrome_policy_page_test: chrome://policy/ navigation itself returned net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR under Playwright; filesystem-managed policy files therefore provide the authoritative observed policy evidence.

launch_configuration.note: No Playwright proxy or host-resolver override was observed.

direct_chromium_test.root_invocation: Direct headless Chromium as root failed before navigation because Chromium refuses root execution without --no-sandbox; no security-disabling flag was added for this diagnostic.
direct_chromium_test.nonroot_invocation: A direct Chromium attempt under nobody with an isolated HOME/XDG runtime did not produce a useful navigation result before timeout, so it is inconclusive rather than evidence against the managed-policy finding.

proxy_environment.note: No external proxy environment variables were set; no proxy credentials were exposed. This does not match the failure signature as strongly as URLBlocklist=* does.

root_cause_evidence: Managed Chromium policy explicitly sets URLBlocklist to ["*"].
Playwright Chromium returns the same administrator block for unrelated public HTTPS sites (example.com, github.com, cfb.fan, cfb.fan/prices), proving the block is not CFB.FAN-specific.
No Playwright proxy flags or external proxy environment variables were observed.
The browser error net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR is consistent with URL blocking by managed browser policy.
safe_remediation: Use a browser execution surface that is already authorized by the environment for external navigation, or request an administrator-managed allow policy for the required public domains through the normal platform mechanism. Do not remove URL filtering or weaken system security. In practical terms, the environment must provide a rendered-browser path whose managed URL policy allows external web navigation (at minimum cfb.fan and any needed dependencies).

retest.reason: No alternate authorized browser executable/path was present, and modifying managed URLBlocklist policy would violate the user's security constraints.

notes: Acceptance path A satisfied: root cause and safe remediation identified.
